mapper.select: -- 관리자 대시보드용 사용자와 역할 수를 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) AS integer) AS total_user_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE u.status_code = 'ACTIVE' ) AS integer) AS active_user_count, CAST(count(DISTINCT ur_user.user_id) AS integer) AS user_role_count, CAST(count(DISTINCT ur_partner.user_id) AS integer) AS partner_role_count, CAST(count(DISTINCT ur_operator.user_id) AS integer) AS operator_role_count, CAST(count(DISTINCT ur_approver.user_id) AS integer) AS approver_role_count, CAST(count(DISTINCT ur_admin.user_id) AS integer) AS admin_role_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_roles ur_user ON ur_user.user_id = u.id AND ur_user.role_code = 'USER' LEFT JOIN user_roles ur_partner ON ur_partner.user_id = u.id AND ur_partner.role_code = 'PARTNER' LEFT JOIN user_roles ur_operator ON ur_operator.user_id = u.id AND ur_operator.role_code = 'OPERATOR' LEFT JOIN user_roles ur_approver ON ur_approver.user_id = u.id AND ur_approver.role_code = 'APPROVER' LEFT JOIN user_roles ur_admin ON ur_admin.user_id = u.id AND ur_admin.role_code = 'ADMIN'

-- 관리자 대시보드용 공고 승인과 운영 상태를 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) AS integer) AS total_announcement_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'DRAFT' ) AS integer) AS draft_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'REQUESTED' ) AS integer) AS requested_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS integer) AS approved_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'REJECTED' ) AS integer) AS rejected_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND a.manual_status_code = 'NORMAL' AND ( a.application_end_date IS NULL OR a.application_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ) ) AS integer) AS open_announcement_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.manual_status_code IN ('PAUSED', 'SUSPENDED', 'HIDDEN') ) AS integer) AS paused_announcement_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE a.manual_status_code IN ('EARLY_CLOSED', 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED', 'CLOSED') OR a.application_end_date < CURRENT_DATE ) AS integer) AS closed_announcement_count FROM announcements a
-- 관리자 대시보드용 파트너 검증 상태별 건수를 집계한다. SELECT pv.status_code, CAST(count(1) AS integer) AS count FROM partner_verifications pv GROUP BY pv.status_code ORDER BY pv.status_code ASC
-- 관리자 대시보드용 매칭 케이스 상태별 건수를 집계한다. SELECT mc.status_code, CAST(count(1) AS integer) AS count FROM matching_cases mc GROUP BY mc.status_code ORDER BY mc.status_code ASC

-- 관리자 대시보드용 신청 진행 상태와 수령 금액 합계를 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) AS integer) AS total_progress_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'READY' ) AS integer) AS ready_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'IN_PROGRESS' ) AS integer) AS in_progress_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'WAITING_RESULT' ) AS integer) AS waiting_result_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'APPROVED' ) AS integer) AS approved_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'REJECTED' ) AS integer) AS rejected_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'SUPPLEMENT_REQUESTED' ) AS integer) AS supplement_requested_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'STOPPED' ) AS integer) AS stopped_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE ap.status_code = 'COMPLETED' ) AS integer) AS completed_count, COALESCE( sum( CASE WHEN ap.received_amount IS NOT NULL AND ( ap.status_code IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED') OR ap.result_code = 'APPROVED' ) THEN ap.received_amount ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS total_received_amount FROM application_progresses ap

-- 관리자 대시보드용 감사 로그 성공/실패 현황을 집계한다. SELECT CAST(count(1) AS integer) AS total_audit_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE al.result_code = 'FAIL' ) AS integer) AS fail_audit_count, CAST(count(1) FILTER ( WHERE al.result_code = 'FAIL' AND al.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' ) AS integer) AS recent_fail_audit_count FROM audit_logs al
